elem-group: real zero-width GROUP boundary marker, no capture extraction yet (nothing needs it). is-match-alt: binary alternation over two separate pattern Vecs, matching regex/pcre.prn's leftmost-first order -- deliberately narrower than GRAMMAR.md's flat embedded-ALT-token shape, named as follow-up. New GROUP/ALT self-test cases. make test-base4-pattern green, -Werror clean. PARENA commit 74104d3.
